# Failure of unique factorization in the ring of integers generated by square root of minus five

↑ **Parent:** [Unique factorization domain](unique-factorization-domain.md)

This [integral domain](integral-domain.md) embeds in $\mathbb C$ but has the inequivalent factorizations $6=2\cdot3=(1+\sqrt{-5})(1-\sqrt{-5})$. The multiplicative [norm](norm.md) $N(a+b\sqrt{-5})=a^2+5b^2$ takes neither the value two nor three, proving that the four displayed factors are [irreducible elements](irreducible-element.md). Its only [units](unit-in-a-ring.md) are $\pm1$, so those two factorizations cannot be related by units and reordering.
